caption: The drawing features three views of a rectangular, decorated wooden box with a handle. The box is predominantly blue with decorative floral and geometric patterns in red, green, yellow, orange, and white. In the top view, the box is shown from the front, displaying two sets of stylized flowers with green leaves and yellow petals, flanking a central blue diamond shape with small white dots. The sides of the box extend upward and outward into pointed shapes, each with a yellow spiral design. The handle at the top is red. The middle image shows a top-down view of the box lid, which is oval-shaped with a red border, yellow dots along the edge, stylized brown and yellow flowers on either side, and a central geometric diamond motif with green, red, and blue patterns. The bottom view presents the opposite side of the box, which also has a red handle and angled side projections with yellow spirals. This side features a floral design with a large red flower on the left, green leaves, and swirling brown stems. A wide, curved banner in the center contains text in decorative script and is highlighted by a white background with red, blue, and yellow ornamental designs. The entire drawing is set against a plain cream-colored background.
title: Sewing Box
